北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气弥漫，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全和保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Foggy conditions, low visibility. Please drive safely and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 细雨霏霏，出门记得带伞，路上湿滑，请小心慢行。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Light rain today, remember your umbrella. Roads might be slick, please walk carefully.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨绵绵，出门别忘带雨具，气温适中，注意添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Drizzling rain, don't forget your rain gear. Temperature is mild, dress appropriately.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气浓重，能见度低。体感温暖，但湿度大，请注意除湿。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog and low visibility. Feels warm but very humid, mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气弥漫，体感温暖。能见度不高，出行请注意安全。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Foggy and feels warm. Visibility is low, please travel safely.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气笼罩，能见度低。路面湿滑，请小心驾驶，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Foggy with low visibility. Roads may be slick, drive carefully and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气浓郁，能见度低，请小心驾驶。体感略凉，注意防潮。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog, low visibility, please drive carefully. Feels a bit cool, watch out for dampness.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光正好，气温适宜，但湿度偏高，记得多补充水分哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant, but humidity is high. Remember to stay hydrated!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气缭绕，能见度不高。湿度大，体感略凉，出行注意添衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Foggy with low visibility. Very humid and feels a bit cool, dress warmly when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 天气晴朗，阳光不错。体感微凉，记得添件衣服，小心着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Clear and sunny. Feels a bit cool, remember to add a layer and avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，阳光正好，气温舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies and pleasant sunshine. Temperatures are comfortable, stay hydrated and cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 气温较低，风力较大，体感寒冷！务必穿暖和，注意防风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Low temperatures and strong winds, it feels freezing! Make sure to dress warmly and stay protected from wind.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气弥漫，能见度不高。体感偏凉，外出请注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Foggy with low visibility. Feels a bit cool, please stay warm when you're out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温适中。注意早晚温差，出行记得添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy skies and moderate temperatures. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, dress in layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气朦胧，能见度低。气温舒适，但路面湿滑，注意慢行。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Misty fog and low visibility. Temperatures are comfortable, but roads may be slick, proceed carefully.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气弥漫，能见度低。体感湿凉，出门注意保暖防潮。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Foggy with low visibility. Feels damp and cool, dress warmly and mind the humidity.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气浓郁，能见度低。体感湿凉，小心驾驶，注意保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog and low visibility. Feels damp and cool, drive carefully and stay warm.
